resources.string: In the “%1$s” tab, a new Home page shows your themes as pictures, with quick adjustments.
Style pickers now show your own watch instead of a list of names.
The Svartifoss notification has a “%1$s” button and shows the next track.
A YouTube Music playlist lists its songs on the watch’s shortcut screen.
The quick panel can use the playing app’s own like, shuffle and repeat buttons.
Fixed: shortcuts starting the wrong music, and long titles running into the controls.
